title: PeerReveal: Learning to Generalize in AI Peer Review Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.33555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can we distinguish fully AI-generated reviews from those using AI only to rewrite human judgement? Furthermore, can we do so reliably when reviews are generated from diverse AI models and workflows across scientific domains? To this end, we introduce PeerReveal, a new detector that grounds its decisions in learned relationships between a review's claims and reference claims drawn from AI-generated reviews of the same paper, complemented by review-level textual signals. We evaluate PeerReveal on PeerShift, a new, challenging test set of 5,430 reviews spanning multiple domains, including machine learning, life sciences, and social sciences, combining variation in disciplinary review conventions with diverse AI review-production mechanisms. With regular training, PeerReveal achieves 70.52% pooled Macro-F1 on this benchmark, improving over the strongest baseline by 11.48 points. translated_title: PeerReveal：学习在AI同行评审检测中的泛化能力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33555v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：我们能否区分完全由AI生成的评审与仅使用AI改写人类判断的评审？此外，当评审来自跨越不同科学领域、多样化AI模型和工作流程时，我们能否可靠地做到这一点？为此，我们推出了PeerReveal，一种新型检测器，其决策基于学习到的评审声明与同一论文的AI生成评审中参考声明之间的关系，并结合评审层面的文本信号。我们在PeerShift上评估PeerReveal，这是一个新的、具有挑战性的测试集，包含5,430篇跨越多个领域（包括机器学习、生命科学和社会科学）的评审，结合了学科评审惯例的差异与多样化的AI评审生成机制。通过常规训练，PeerReveal在该基准上实现了70.52%的合并Macro-F1，较最强基线提升了11.48个百分点。我们还开发了一种有效且实用的对抗性训练框架。
tldr: 该论文提出了PeerReveal检测器，通过学习评审声明与同一论文AI生成评审的参考声明之间的关系来检测AI生成的同行评审，并在覆盖多个学科、融合多样化AI生成机制的PeerShift新基准上显著超越最强基线。
